required_order_constraints: Browser calls Web BFF/API gateway, which calls POST api/v1/Basket/checkout.
Basket reads Redis before publishing UserCheckoutAcceptedIntegrationEvent.
Basket publishes UserCheckoutAcceptedIntegrationEvent before returning HTTP 202 through the Web BFF to the browser.
Asynchronous Ordering work occurs after the HTTP acceptance boundary from the caller's perspective.
Ordering consumes UserCheckoutAcceptedIntegrationEvent and dispatches idempotent IdentifiedCommand<CreateOrderCommand, bool> using RequestId.
Ordering creates and commits the order in Ordering SQL before publishing OrderStartedIntegrationEvent and OrderStatusChangedToSubmittedIntegrationEvent.
Basket consumes OrderStartedIntegrationEvent and deletes the checked-out basket from Redis.
Catalog consumes OrderStatusChangedToAwaitingValidationIntegrationEvent and validates/decrements stock in Catalog SQL.
The stock-confirmed and stock-rejected outcomes branch only after shared processing.
On confirmation, Ordering changes state and OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEvent reaches Payment and Ordering SignalR Hub.
Payment publishes OrderPaymentSuccededIntegrationEvent; Ordering consumes it and marks the order paid in Ordering SQL.
On rejection, Ordering consumes the stock result and cancels the order in Ordering SQL.
required_view_semantics: The artifact makes interaction order legible as a sequence, not only as static topology.
HTTP returns are visually distinguishable from calls or publications.
The success and stock-rejection alternatives are visibly distinct.
Exact supplied contract names and the evidenced spelling OrderPaymentSuccededIntegrationEvent are preserved.
unknown_or_unsupported: Payment-failure event contract, consumer, state transition, store write, and notification are not supplied.
The exact stock-result contract names are not supplied.
The exact paid-status contract name is not supplied.
The supplied excerpts establish consumption but not the producer transition for OrderStatusChangedToAwaitingValidationIntegrationEvent.
The final recipient or transport beyond Ordering SignalR Hub is not supplied.
forbidden_inventions: Named payment-failure event or terminal state
